description: Adapted from Grafana dashboard 25152 for Qdrant 1.16.3 native /metrics with QDRANT__SERVICE__METRICS_PREFIX="qdrant_". Panels that depended on external qdrant_exporter or Qdrant Cloud metrics were replaced with native equivalents where possible.

panels.description: Total number of collections in this Qdrant instance
panels.title: Collections

panels.description: Sum of all points across selected collections
panels.title: Total Points

panels.description: Qdrant 1.16 API metrics are global by endpoint/status, not per collection. This sums REST and gRPC endpoints that look search/query related.
panels.title: Search-like API / s

panels.description: Uses qdrant_rest_responses_avg_duration_seconds for search/query-like REST endpoints. For more precise latency use histogram panels or endpoint-specific filters.
panels.title: Avg REST Search-like Latency

panels.description: Searches per second vs failures per second. The hero chart — tells you immediately if traffic is flowing and healthy.
panels.title: Search-like API Rate - Live

panels.description: Total active memory of the Qdrant process
panels.title: Active RAM

panels.description: Native /metrics in 1.16 does not expose per-collection disk bytes. This panel now shows total vectors.
panels.title: Total Vectors

panels.description: Ratio of failed searches to total over the last 5 minutes
panels.title: Search Error Rate

panels.description: Qdrant server version
panels.title: Qdrant Version

panels.description: Qdrant exposes cluster_voter, not a per-node leader gauge. 1 means voter, 0 means learner.
panels.title: Consensus Voter

panels.description: Native /metrics does not expose active shard transfers. This replacement shows the sum of minimum active replicas.
panels.title: Active Replicas Min

panels.description: Native /metrics does not expose resharding operations. This replacement shows dead replicas.
panels.title: Dead Replicas

panels.description: Native /metrics does not expose shard-transfer/resharding gauges. This replacement tracks replica health gauges.
panels.title: Replica Health Activity

panels.description: Qdrant 1.16 does not support per-collection API response metrics; per-collection API labels start in v1.18 with /metrics?per_collection=true.
panels.title: Search-like Requests / s - By Endpoint

panels.description: Qdrant 1.16 API latency is by endpoint, not collection.
panels.title: Avg Search-like Latency - By Endpoint

panels.description: Original search_type dimension is not in native Qdrant /metrics. Endpoint is the closest native dimension.
panels.title: Search-like Volume by Endpoint

panels.description: Original search_type dimension is not in native Qdrant /metrics. Endpoint is the closest native dimension.
panels.title: Latency by Search-like Endpoint

panels.description: Native 1.16 error counters are global by endpoint/status, not collection.
panels.title: Search-like Error Rate - By Status

panels.description: Dataset growth over time. Solid = vectors (includes multi-vectors), dashed = points (unique documents).
panels.title: Points & Vectors Per Collection

panels.description: Qdrant exposes indexed_only excluded points, not an exporter indexed_ratio. This panel approximates coverage as 1 - excluded/vectors.
panels.title: Indexed Coverage Proxy

panels.description: Optimizer runs/s and active tasks per collection. Spikes = active HNSW builds or segment compaction.
panels.title: Running Optimizations

panels.description: Qdrant native metrics expose indexed_only excluded points, not deleted vectors pending compaction.
panels.title: Indexed-only Excluded Points

panels.description: Process active RAM (total Qdrant) vs sum of collection storage RAM.
panels.title: RAM Usage

panels.description: Native /metrics in 1.16 does not expose collection disk usage. This replacement shows vectors by collection/vector name.
panels.title: Vectors - Per Collection

panels.description: Native /metrics does not expose collection RAM bytes. This replacement shows vector IO read/write rate.
panels.title: Vector IO Rate - Per Collection

panels.description: Native /metrics does not expose collection RAM trend. This replacement shows payload IO rates.
panels.title: Payload IO Rate - Per Collection

panels.description: Native /metrics does not expose collection disk bytes. This replacement shows collection CPU metric rate.
panels.title: Collection CPU Metric Rate
